name: Lasgun Recolored
author: crystal-mods
description: Recolours the Astra Militarum Lasgun to match the appearance of Lasguns from the Dawn of War and Space Marine series. Provides an alternative to the vanilla yellow/orange colour. Cosmetic/FX only; gameplay is unchanged.

projectileColour.to: red (bolt + muzzle flash + flare + hit disperse; shared LasGun FX, affects all AM las weapons)

optionalChanges.note: Applied only when built with --stats (off by default).
